description: Convert breath alcohol (mg/l, what a roadside breathalyser measures) to blood alcohol (permille) or back, at the German legal ratio 1:2000 (0.25 mg/l = 0.5 permille). Give exactly one of breath_mg_per_l or blood_permille. The individual ratio varies, so the result is the legal equivalent, not a measurement.
name: convert_breath_blood_alcohol
title: Convert breath alcohol and blood alcohol
